normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 terms are absent from every translation and are not accepted search concepts.

source_native_implementation.boolean_form: Fully parenthesized AND/OR expressions; every normative literal is retained as a quoted atom.
source_native_implementation.phrase_policy: Every multiword dictionary entry remains one quoted ordered phrase; punctuation and hyphen normalization are untested.
source_native_implementation.acronym_policy: Quoted single-token literals are retained; standalone-token behavior is untested.
source_native_implementation.stemming_and_expansion: No stemming, lemmatization, spelling, plural/adjective, or automatic expansion is assumed by the translation; current behavior is untested.
source_native_implementation.pair_semantics: NEAR/6 is the source-native draft candidate for unordered pairs with at most five intervening lexical tokens. Direction, distance, phrase-tokenization, and same-NOFT-field behavior are untested; pair-bearing partitions cannot be accepted on this draft alone.

subject_index_fields.purpose: title metadata field syntax and behavior
abstract metadata field syntax and behavior

subject_and_index_probes.thesaurus: No thesaurus, hierarchy, narrower-term, explosion, or descriptor assignment is accepted without a current normal-interface observation.

controlled_vocabulary.reason: No current interface observation is being claimed. Subject/index probes and any visible thesaurus or hierarchy must be tested before a descriptor can supplement a mapped free-text block.

query_length_and_cell_policy.adapter_ceiling_basis: static local adapter validation only; not a provider query-length observation
query_length_and_cell_policy.current_cells: One complete source-native cell per partition; no offline cell is split or narrowed.
query_length_and_cell_policy.future_split_rule: If a current source limit rejects a complete cell, define a lossless union of complete cells before execution, retain every cell query/total/ID set, and reconcile the stable-ID union. A failure never authorizes a narrower replacement.

lossless_union_rule.identity: Numeric ProQuest document ID only after nonempty uniqueness and repeatability are observed.
lossless_union_rule.one_cell_identity: A one-cell partition has the identity union of its sole cell, subject to later source validation.
lossless_union_rule.failure: Access, syntax, field, control, total, pagination, detail, identity, export, or completeness failure makes that cell total null and imports no prefix.

lossless_union.rationale: One offline cell contains the complete dictionary Boolean expression. No source query-length or parser limit has been observed.

source_boundary.interface: normal rendered ProQuest database selector and Command Line Search UI
allowed_database_labels: ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global Full Text Included
source_boundary.selection_rule: Select exactly one PQDT-labelled checkbox; preferred diagnostic selection is ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global. Never select both labels, ATAI, or any other ProQuest database. This event and all totals remain separate from S-D07.

controls.date: Pilot diagnostic lower bound 2011-01-01 and upper bound 2026-08-25; exact query suffix candidate is YR(2011-2026), which is year-granular and not P-001.
controls.language: Pilot query suffix candidate LA(English); current adapter has no separate language flag, and full-report language remains a screening field.
controls.content: Do not impose degree type, publication type, full-text, access, peer-review, venue, or content restrictions during discovery.
controls.result_controls: Static adapter contract targets relevance, 20 records/page, source duplicate exclusion off, spelling and plural/adjective variants on, and full-text limiter off; current interface persistence is untested.
controls.export: No RIS/full-text export; bounded normalized metadata/abstract JSON/CSV is diagnostic only.
